name: open
description: Open files or URLs in the user's desktop applications via xdg-open — show a produced file, pop a browser tab, reveal output in the file manager. 'mime' reports the registered default handler.
use_when: showing the user a file or URL in their desktop apps

args.name: open <path|url>
args.description: Open in the default app (file type or browser).

args.name: open --reveal <path>
args.description: Reveal the file in the file manager.

args.name: mime <path>
args.description: Report the file's mime type and default handler.
